conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Galton Board
style.description: A Galton board (bean machine) on a bright oak desk: a glass-fronted maple frame, an enamel-blue backboard with a triangular field of brass pegs, a walnut hopper with a brass spout and polished steel balls. A seeded, precomputed ball plan (plinko.js) gives every ball its left/right choice at each peg row, a closed-form path (drop, one parabolic hop per row, ballistic fall into its bin, two small bounces) and a stack slot, so the histogram grows ball by ball into a bell curve. Pegs flash and swell when struck; every peg tick, release click and bin landing (one marimba note per bin) is a sound cue from the same plan. A red enamel bell curve is drawn on the glass over the finished stacks.
motion: Balls are the only actors. Each ball is a closed-form function of time from plinko.js: drop from the spout, one parabolic hop per peg row (left or right from a seeded choice), a ballistic fall into its bin, two small bounces, rest in its stack slot.
Stack slots are handed out in arrival order per bin (three abreast), so the histogram grows ball by ball and never rearranges.
A struck peg flashes and swells for a tenth of a second; ticks, release clicks and one marimba note per bin come from the same plan.
Camera: frontal, a few slow moves from the hopper down to the bins, locked during holds; the bell curve is drawn on the glass left to right.

beats.label: Every peg is a coin flip

notes.mechanism: plinko.js: per ball a seeded left/right choice per peg row -> closed-form path (drop, parabolic hop per row, ballistic fall, two bounces) -> bin and stack slot in arrival order. Struck pegs flash from the plan's hit times. SCORE = scoreFromEvents(plan events).
notes.data: SAMPLE DATA: the histogram is one seeded run of fair left/right choices (seed picked for a clean bell); no numbers are shown on screen.
